newsitem.title: USA: Lockwood Greene says has aquired Skanska unit.
newsitem.headline: Lockwood Greene says has aquired Skanska unit.

text.p: Lockwood Greene said on Thursday it had succesfully completed the acquisition of Skanska Engineering and Construction, an Indianapolis-based subsidiary of Swedish construction group Skanska AB.
In March, Skanska USA signed a letter of intent for Lockwood Greene to acquire Skanska E&C, Lockwood said in a statement.
Lockwood Greene, a subsidiary of German construction company Philipp Holzmann AG, declined to comment on how much the aquisition had cost.
Lockwood Greene also said that Bill Leslie would continue as operating board executive for the new subsidiary, called Lockwood Greene Co of Indiana.
In addition, "Hank Salzberg, president, and Alan Grinstad, director of operations, will continue acting in the same capacity as they did under the previous ownership," Lockwood Greene said.
Lockwood Greene is a global consulting, design, and construction firm.
